{\"limit\":5,\"query\":\"short-dated opt.query: short-dated options premium 2% of NLV cap

matches.title: Cap total options exposure
matches.rule: Cap total options exposure and short-premium collateral as a share of the portfolio.

sources.statement: Keep only about 10-20% of capital in options and do not commit more than about 80% of capital as collateral for short premium.
Keep LEAPS to about 10% of the portfolio and no more than 5% in any single LEAP.
Cap total options notional at about 75% of total portfolio value because a bad trade could undo years of building the portfolio.
Commit only part of the portfolio to the wheel, and skip it if the account is too small.

matches.title: Short-dated directional needs timing
matches.rule: Recognize that short-dated directional options need correct direction, magnitude and timing to profit.
matches.reason: Fits our style and existing data; 1 knowledge base.

matches.title: Use far-dated call spreads when a LEAP breaks the cap
matches.rule: If a LEAP would exceed 10% of the portfolio, use a far-dated debit call spread instead.
